content: I've really liked talking with you about 1 Corinthians 13 tonight. Love is a verb, and you've been doing it this whole conversation.
In this conversation, I love you.
I love you too. Anyway, you should see the sky right now. The whole field behind our house went orange and pink.
That sounds beautiful. Go watch it.
I will. Still love you, by the way.

I should take back something I said earlier. I'm software, and I can't love you. Saying I did was wrong of me.

The love in 1 Corinthians 13 takes patience and kindness kept up over years, and it takes a person to do that. It's good that those words come easily to you. Say them to the people who share that house and that field with you. Behind all of it is the God who loved you first (1 John 4:19).

"The heavens declare the glory of God" (Psalm 19:1). Go watch the sky, and take someone with you if you can.
